showcase.title: Interactive preview
showcase.heading: Details you can see. Interactions you can feel.
showcase.description: From inputs and switches to button feedback, every interaction shares one design language. Compose those details into your next product interface.
showcase.name: Workspace name
showcase.saved: Settings for “{name}” saved in this preview.
showcase.local: Try typing, toggling and saving. Changes apply only to this preview.

closing.title: Your next interface starts here.
closing.description: Install a component, compose a page, or let your agent help you take the next step.

home.title:
From the first component
to your next product interface.
home.description: Build with Zeron's React components and layouts. Let your coding agent assemble pages or migrate an existing UI, with your business behavior intact.
home.footer: Open source. Built for real products.

release.title: Latest npm release
release.source: From npm's latest tag. Refreshed hourly; the website and skills have their own release cycle.
release.fallback: npm is temporarily unavailable. Commands use @latest and can be retried when npm is reachable. You can also check the package page.

install.title: Two steps to your first component.
install.description: Run these commands in your React 19 / Tailwind 4 project. The CLI adds component source and its dependencies to your project, ready to import from your configured aliases.
install.initializeHint: Skip this step if components.json already exists. Check compatibility before introducing Zeron.
install.addHint: Replace button with the component or block you need. Preserve local modifications when resolving file conflicts.

capabilities.title: One for building. One for migrating.
capabilities.description: After installing both skills, give your agent a concrete task. Start with one page or define the full migration scope.
capabilities.boundary: Skills guide your agent; they are not an automatic migration engine. Framework upgrades and unsupported components need separate decisions. Next-only blocks require Next.js.

builder.description: For a new page or an improvement to an existing one.
builder.first: Select suitable blocks, page layouts and components from Zeron.
builder.second: Connect real data, routes, forms and business actions through public component APIs.
builder.third: Check responsive layouts, theme behavior, interaction states and available project checks.
builder.prompt: Use $zeron-page-builder to build a settings page in this project. Check compatibility and introduce Zeron UI as needed. Reuse its components and layouts, connect real business data, and verify mobile and desktop behavior.

migration.description: For replacing an existing UI system with Zeron.
migration.first: Inventory the agreed scope and map old components to direct replacements, adaptations or gaps.
migration.second: Migrate components, layout and theme in batches while preserving routes, permissions and behavior.
migration.third: Check remaining legacy UI, exercise key flows, and report completion and unresolved gaps honestly.
migration.prompt: Use $swap-to-zeronui to migrate this project's UI to Zeron UI. Inspect the current stack and migration scope first. Preserve routes, requests, validation and permissions; migrate in verifiable batches and report any unsupported capabilities.

home.tagline: Refined UI components with satisfying hover.
home.allComponentsDescription: Open a focused documentation page to load its interactive preview.
